headline: Add free-agent QB Drew Lock now (no bid, no one else in the league has him) — he starts again with Darnold out and fixes your week 6 Burrow/Willis bye clash — then swap MarShawn Lloyd in for Kenny Gainwell before Sunday's 10:00 AM PT kickoffs.
summary: Danny is 1-0 with an open bench spot and no Questionable starters this week, so this is about upgrading the FLEX and locking in cheap QB insurance. Lloyd has taken over Green Bay's early-down work with Jacobs on the exempt list, while Gainwell remains Tampa's clear passing-down 1B behind Bucky Irving.

lineup.why: Lloyd is now Green Bay's early-down back with more confirmed volume (10.7 projected carries) than Gainwell's passing-down role (6.7) behind Tampa's clear starter Bucky Irving.
lineup.evidence: Lloyd (GB): Josh Jacobs remains on the commissioner's exempt list facing misdemeanor charges with no return date (placed Aug 31 2026); Lloyd out-carried Chris Brooks 13-7 last week playing early-down/short-yardage snaps (Draft Sharks, reported this week). Gainwell (TB): Bucky Irving is the clear 1A starter; Gainwell is the 1B passing-down piece, out-snapped 62%-46% and out-targeted 26%-4% by Irving in Week 1 (CBS Sports/Pewter Report, reported this week).

adds.why: A real starting NFL QB, free, and nobody else in this superflex league owns him; his bye (week 11) covers the week Burrow and Willis both sit.
adds.evidence: Sam Darnold (hip/glute strain, no timeline given by the team) is out again and Lock starts at Arizona Sunday for the second straight week (CBS Sports, Sept 10-14 2026); Seahawks' bye is week 11, clear of Burrow's and Willis's shared week 6 bye.

alerts.body: Lloyd is Green Bay's new early-down back with Jacobs on the exempt list (13 carries last week); Gainwell is stuck as Tampa's passing-down 1B. Swap before Sunday 10:00 AM PT kickoff.

alerts.title: ➕ Grab Drew Lock free, no bid
alerts.body: Lock starts again for Seattle with Darnold out and nobody in the league owns him. His week 11 bye also covers your Burrow/Willis week 6 clash. Add now before another team does.
